after.r2121_malonyl_coa_close_evidence: KEGG R00740 / EC 1.2.1.75 is the malonyl-CoA reductase (malonate semialdehyde-forming) of the 3-hydroxypropanoate CO2-fixation cycles of green non-sulfur bacteria and thermoacidophilic archaea. YALI1C02550g is KEGG yli:2909116, K00140 (EC 1.2.1.18 / 1.2.1.27); its reaction R00705 is R2119 in this model, kept. KEGG lists no K15017 gene for Y. lipolytica or S. cerevisiae; Yeast-GEM carries R00705 and not R00740, eciYali5-GEM neither (checked 2026-11-10).
after.r2121_malonyl_coa_close_effect: Stage 1 on e584151f (Task A medium + PO1f, Gurobi 1e-9): WT growth -0.139 %; cytosolic malonyl-CoA moves to the acetyl-CoA carboxylase R88; a pFBA TAG lipolysis, beta-oxidation and elongation cycle on glucose stops.
after.r2121_malonyl_coa_close_limits: Inherited from iYli21 with no recorded reason. Absence from KEGG and from the yeast models is annotation-level evidence, not an enzyme assay; no Y. lipolytica enzyme data. Chemistry unchanged (charge -1 on the substrate side as inherited). The inherited ec-code annotation 1.2.1.27 is the EC of the K00140 group of YALI1C02550g, not of R00740 (EC 1.2.1.75); annotations are not changed here.
after.r2121_malonyl_coa_close_authorization: User authorized closing R2121 to (0, 0), reaction and GPR kept, on 2026-11-12 after the Stage 1 report (model/reports/r2121_malonyl_coa_20261110/).
